2. Electro-hydraulic Servo-driven Static Performance Testing Machine

The electro-hydraulic servo-driven static performance testing machine uses an electro-hydraulic servo/proportional control system. It can apply static force, as well as apply force with an electronic universal/fatigue testing function. In JB/T 8612-2015, the types, designations, and specifications of electro-hydraulic servo static performance testing machines are specified, including: test machine main parameter series, technical requirements, inspection methods, marking, packaging and shipping, and applicable materials including metal and non-metal materials. It covers static, dynamic force/performance testing machines used for electrical hydraulic servo-driven static performance testing machines (hereinafter referred to as testing machines).

In JB/T 8612-2015, the standard references cited include: GB/T 2611-2007 (Testing Machine General Technical Requirements), GB/T 16825.1-2008 (Calibration of Static Uniaxial Testing Machines Part 1: Tension and (or) Compression Force Testing Machine Force System Calibration and Verification), GB/T 25917-2010 (Axial Force Fatigue Testing Machine Dynamic Force Calibration) and JB/T 6146-2007 (Extensometer Technical Conditions), etc.
In JB/T 8612-2015, the classification of testing machines is removed.
(1) Testing Machine Main Parameter Series

The main parameter of the testing machine is the maximum static test force, and the main parameters are used to classify testing machine specifications, while the main parameters also represent the maximum capacity of the testing machine. The main parameter values are set according to Table 4-133.

sections.text: (2) Technical Requirements
1) Environmental and working conditions. The testing machine should operate normally under the following conditions: a) Room temperature 10-35°C range.
b) Relative humidity not greater than 80%.
c) Surrounding environment free of corrosive media.
d) Power supply voltage fluctuation range within ±10% of the rated voltage.
e) Installed on a stable foundation, level, with a horizontality of 0.2/1000.
2) Loading System
General requirements:

The testing machine frame should have sufficient rigidity and testing space, and should facilitate various tests. It should be easy to install test fixtures, as well as the removal of testing machine accessories and the installation of measuring instruments.

The testing machine should be able to work normally within its specified range of amplitude characteristics. The testing machine should have smooth and stable processes during loading and unloading, including impact and vibration resistance.
a) Hydraulic system. The hydraulic system's hydraulic fluid, seals, pipelines, and interfaces should comply with the requirements of Chapter 8 of GB/T 2611-2007.
b) Tension testing machine clamps. The testing machine tensile testing clamp fixtures should comply with the technical requirements of JB/T 8612-2015.
c) Compression testing machine fixtures. The testing machine compression test fixture device technical requirements should comply with JB/T 8612-2015.
d) Bending test fixture device. The testing machine bending test fixture device technical requirements should comply with JB/T 8612-2015.
3) Force Measurement System
General requirements:

a) The force measurement is achieved through a computer-based digital display indicator, and the force measurement device should display the measured value clearly, be easy to read, and the digits of the force measurement indicator display should be clear.
b) Regardless of the type of indicator, the indicator device should be able to directly display the force value.
4) Testing Machine Accuracy and Calibration Site
The testing machine accuracy verification and calibration site should comply with specified requirements, and the test records should include the peak value of the measured cycle.
The force measurement device has a clear (clean) reading function.
c) The test loading time should not exceed 30min, and every 15min the zero point drift should not exceed the maximum allowable value of the force measurement range lower limit of ±1%.
5) Static Force
a) The maximum allowable value of relative error of the static force value is ±1%. The static force indication repeatability error should not be greater than 1%.
b) The maximum allowable value of the zero return error (reversibility) is ±1.5%.

c) The maximum allowable value of zero point alignment error is ±0.5%. The minimum resolution of the testing machine force system's relative partial resolution force is 0.5%. The resolution of the force system should not be greater than the lower limit value of the measurement range of 0.25%.

3. Technical Requirements for Shearing Machines
(1) General Requirements

items: 1) The shearing machine should comply with JB/T 1829 requirements.

2) The drawings and technical documents of the shearing machine should comply with technical document requirements, and should be manufactured only after being reviewed and approved according to prescribed procedures.
3) The rigidity of the shearing machine should comply with the technical document requirements.
4) The instruction manual should comply with GB/T 9969 requirements.

sections.text: (2) Model and Basic Parameters
The model and basic parameters of the shearing machine should comply with JB/T 1826 requirements. The shearing machine blade should comply with JB/T 1828.1, JB/T 1828.2 requirements.
(3) Accessories and Matching Parts

When the shearing machine leaves the factory, it should be ensured to be complete, and should have the correct dedicated tools and accessories and easily damaged parts. Special spare parts shall be negotiated by the user and the manufacturer. The manufacturer should supply or assist in procurement.

The external parts (including mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic components, etc.) supporting the manufacture must have qualification certificates, and be tested with the host machine for trial operation.
(4) Safety and Protection
The safety and protection of the shearing machine should comply with GB 28240 requirements.
(5) Structure and Performance
The rigidity of the shearing machine should comply with the technical document requirements.
The structural and performance requirements should refer to JB/T 5197.2-2015.
(6) Nameplate

items: 1) The shearing machine should have nameplates and indicating signs for operation, safety, and other required marks and labels. The nameplate requirements should comply with GB/T 13306. The graphic symbols on the nameplate should comply with JB/T 3240.
2) The nameplate should be securely affixed in a conspicuous and appropriate position.

sections.text: (7) Castings, Forgings, Welded Parts
Gray cast iron should comply with JB/T 5775. Nodular cast iron, steel castings should have corresponding standard requirements.

Should comply with GB/T 1348 requirements. Cast carbon steel parts should comply with GB/T 11352 requirements. Welding parts should comply with JB/T 8609 requirements. Castings and forgings made of non-ferrous metal should comply with the relevant technical document requirements. For use and appearance defects that do not significantly affect use, under conditions that ensure quality, permitted repairs should be conducted according to the technical document. The composite materials used should comply with the requirements of the technical documents. Steel castings and forgings should comply with JB/T 11196 requirements.

2) Frame (left upright, right upright), upper blade holder, worktable (lower base), connecting rod, large gear, flywheel, eccentric shaft, roller, adjusting rod, adjusting screw, cutter bar, knife edge, reduction box and other important components, as well as parts involving processing and heat treatment for the manufacturing process.
(8) Machining

items: 1) Parts machining should comply with the design, process technique document requirements. The machined surface should not have burrs, cracks, and other defects. Special processing for external surfaces should be handled by removing burrs and sharp edges.

2) Machine frame, upper blade holder, main (drive) shaft, connecting rod, eccentric shaft, roller body, slider, crescent (blade) and other main friction-wearing components should adopt wear-resistant measures.

sections.text: Machining and other requirements refer to JB/T 5197.2-2015.
(9) Electrical Equipment
The electrical equipment of the shearing machine should comply with GB 5226.1 requirements.
(10) Hydraulic, Lubrication, Pneumatic, and Cooling Systems

The hydraulic system of the shearing machine should comply with GB/T 3766 requirements. The hydraulic system should also comply with GB/T 7935 requirements. The pneumatic system should comply with GB/T 7932 requirements. The working parts should not have obvious leakage phenomena during the specified travel, deceleration, vibration, direction change, and pressurization.
Pressure vessels should be designed, manufactured, and inspected in compliance with technical document requirements.

The shearing machine should have reliable lubrication devices, lubrication passages, and lubrication points that should have corresponding standard requirements, ensuring that all rotating parts operate properly.

4. No-load Trial Run Test
1) The hydraulic system matched with the sliding table should comply with GB/T 23572-2009 requirements.

2) The sliding table should be placed on the corresponding test bench and run for no less than 2h no-load trial operation. During this period, all specified working procedures must be completed, including: actions, function checks, and all operating handle transitions should be smooth, no abnormal noise or impact vibration.

The maximum travel length of the sliding table, rapid traverse speed, rapid return speed, and all feed speed ranges should be verified to meet the design requirements. During working feed speed range, the slide should move smoothly with the set position accuracy.
5. Load Test

1) According to the specified maximum rated force for a load test, check the stability of the force. In the condition of the slide at the midpoint of the centerline upper working stroke B/2 (B is the slide stroke), use the load hydraulic cylinder force measurement method for testing.

2) Adjust the feed rate of the slide to the minimum working feed rate, and check at the maximum feed force and no-load conditions the feed speed variation. The variation rate (see formula (4-11)) should not exceed ±15%. In 10 complete cycles, continuously measure 30 times, at which time the slide feed rate is averaged as a percentage. Check the movement of the slide on the front surface, and the table feed rate uniformity is verified.
The vibration and runout should not exceed 0.01mm.
Where: δ — feed speed variation rate; S̄ — average feed speed without load, unit: mm/min; S — specified limit feed speed under load, unit: mm/min.
Other instruments with not less than a percentage accuracy can be used for testing.

3) When the hydraulic system pressure is 7MPa (elongated surface sliding table is 4MPa) and at a certain feed speed, the slide stops and is fixed to the iron plate for 5min. At this time, hydraulic pipe connections, various valve connections, and sealing areas of the hydraulic cylinder should not have oil leakage. The hydraulic system should not show pressure drop phenomena.

The precision of the hydraulic sliding table should be inspected according to JB/T 9889-2013 (Modular Machine Tool Sliding Table Precision Inspection), and the inspection results should be recorded in the product qualification certificate.
4.5.3  Machine Tool (High Speed) Rotary Hydraulic Cylinder

In Reference [15], the typical structure of hydraulic cylinders is described, covering both general-purpose hydraulic cylinder typical structures and special-purpose hydraulic cylinder typical structures and applications.

Barrel-type rotary hydraulic cylinder typical structures include gear-rack rotary hydraulic cylinder, piston-type barrel rotary hydraulic cylinder, vane-type rotary hydraulic cylinder, rolling rotary hydraulic cylinder, and single-cylinder rotary hydraulic cylinder (five types). It also states that: 'Piston rotary hydraulic cylinder is a hydraulic cylinder combined with a rotary mechanism. The rotary mechanism usually consists of gear-rack or helical groove type. This is a type of component that combines the hydraulic cylinder and hydraulic motor functions. The output of the rotary hydraulic cylinder is rotation, and the rotation angle is generally within the 0°-360° range.'

Based on testing or reference materials, refer to Reference [15] for barrel-type hydraulic cylinder typical structures. The differences between barrel-type hydraulic cylinders are described below, noting that column-type hydraulic cylinders and barrel-type hydraulic cylinder structures differ. The following describes column-type hydraulic cylinder and rotary hydraulic cylinder structures. The hydraulic cylinder body and piston rotation are driven by external components, not generated by the hydraulic cylinder itself.
